subject: Mathematics
rule_summary: Most engineering degree routes require Mathematics and provider-specific marks.
learner_warning: Dropping Mathematics can close many university engineering routes. Check each university prospectus before final subject choice.

subject: Physical Sciences
rule_summary: Many engineering degree routes require Physical Sciences and provider-specific marks.
learner_warning: Dropping Physical Sciences can close many university engineering routes. Check each university prospectus before final subject choice.

subject: Mathematics
rule_summary: Quantitative data science routes commonly depend on Mathematics for BSc or statistics-heavy study.
learner_warning: Mathematical Literacy may limit access to many Computer Science Data Science Statistics and Actuarial routes.

subject: Information Technology
rule_summary: IT supports programming thinking but is not always a formal university admission requirement.
learner_warning: Helpful subject but still check Mathematics and degree admission rules.

subject: Computer Applications Technology
rule_summary: CAT can support digital confidence office systems and IT support routes.
learner_warning: CAT alone does not replace Mathematics where a degree route requires Mathematics.

subject: Mathematics
rule_summary: Computer Science and related degree routes often require Mathematics; IT support and vendor routes may be more flexible.
learner_warning: Do not assume all IT routes have the same entry criteria. Degree support technician and vendor routes differ.

subject: Accounting
rule_summary: Accounting is strongly useful for accounting finance and bookkeeping pathways.
learner_warning: Some professional accounting routes may require or prefer Accounting and Mathematics. Verify per programme.

subject: Mathematics
rule_summary: Mathematics supports accounting actuarial finance and quantitative banking routes.
learner_warning: Mathematical Literacy may limit quantitative finance actuarial and some accounting degree options.

subject: Life Sciences
rule_summary: Life Sciences supports health biology nursing and medical study routes where required or recommended.
learner_warning: Health science entry requirements differ widely by institution and programme.

subject: Physical Sciences
rule_summary: Physical Sciences is commonly important for medicine pharmacy and several health science routes.
learner_warning: Check exact programme rules before dropping Physical Sciences if aiming at medicine pharmacy or related health science routes.

subject: Life Sciences
rule_summary: Life Sciences is useful for nursing and care routes and may be required by some providers.
learner_warning: Nursing entry rules differ by provider and qualification type.

subject: Engineering Graphics and Design
rule_summary: EGD supports architecture construction drafting and technical design thinking.
learner_warning: EGD is helpful but not always the only requirement. Check Mathematics and portfolio or provider rules.

subject: Visual Arts
career_cluster: Media Design Film and Creative Arts
rule_summary: Visual Arts supports creative portfolios for design art media and visual communication routes.
learner_warning: Creative routes often need portfolio evidence in addition to school marks.

subject: Design
career_cluster: Media Design Film and Creative Arts
rule_summary: Design supports design thinking portfolio work and creative applications.
learner_warning: A strong portfolio may matter more than one subject but provider rules vary.

subject: Geography
rule_summary: Geography supports environmental planning GIS logistics and earth-related pathways.
learner_warning: Useful subject but exact admission rules are qualification-specific.

subject: Agricultural Sciences
rule_summary: Agricultural Sciences supports farming food environment and agricultural study routes.
learner_warning: Helpful for agri routes but Mathematics Life Sciences or Geography may still matter by programme.

subject: Tourism
rule_summary: Tourism supports hospitality tourism travel and events routes.
learner_warning: Tourism is useful but not the only route into hospitality or travel work.

subject: Consumer Studies
rule_summary: Consumer Studies supports culinary hospitality and service-related pathways.
learner_warning: Practical proof and provider-specific entry rules still matter.

subject: Languages
rule_summary: Strong language ability supports law public service communication and research-heavy routes.
learner_warning: Law entry is provider-specific and may depend on APS and language marks.

subject: History
rule_summary: History supports social context policy law public service and humanities routes.
learner_warning: Helpful subject but does not guarantee public service entry.
